question: What functional unit does the life-cycle assessment of resource recovery from spent FCC catalysts use, and in what software and with what primary impact assessment method were impacts calculated?
rendered: The functional unit used in the life-cycle assessment is the treatment of 1 t (1000 kg) of spent FCC catalyst. The impacts were calculated in SimaPro 10.1 using the Environmental Footprint 3.1 (adapted) as the primary life-cycle impact assessment method.
